reference_scale: MODIS-equivalent detections (Terra + Aqua). From 20 Jan 2012: average of observed MODIS and S-NPP VIIRS converted with a ratio per calendar month. Before 2012: observed MODIS. Terra-only months (Nov 2000 - 3 Jul 2002) scaled to Terra + Aqua. Provisional near-real-time observations after the standard archive; refreshed nightly. NRT has not undergone standard-processing quality control. Where NASA omits fire type, nominal/high-confidence thermal anomalies are retained without a vegetation-only classification. The current UTC day is incomplete and excluded. Gaps are missing, never fabricated zeros.
